From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo: calendar entry shows two join links (one 403)

Sean — looked into the event metadata. Key findings:
- Organizer field is set to "helm-automations@helmfin.com" (a Helm service account) while the event was created via a third-party provisioning flow.
- Google Meet attachment is auto-inserted by Helm's provisioning flow; Zoom was added by our demo scheduler (we attempted to include a backup link).
- The Zoom 403 is coming from the token in the Zoom meeting metadata that references a different Zoom owner account; the alias mismatch causes Zoom to reject the request when clicked from Helm's GSuite UI.

Suggested remediation steps:
1) Resend the invite from Kyla's primary calendar (not the helm-automations service account) so the organizer field is Kyla's address. That should remove the Meet auto-insert.
2) If Kyla wants both links, we should host the Zoom meeting ourselves and provide a shortlink that does not embed organizer tokens.
3) For immediate continuity, Sean's temp Zoom link is fine; I attached meeting-meta.txt with the event headers we saw for debugging.

I can resend an invite from my test account if you want to see the cleaned event without the Meet attachment.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
